chronological_fold_design.design: A deterministic synthetic preparation suite followed, only after separate run approval, by one pre-registered chronological Grade-R card containing all 12 races.
chronological_fold_design.failure_denominator_rule: Every target race remains in the engineering denominator; failures are retained as NO_BET rather than dropped.
chronological_fold_design.future_shadow_rule: The run is engineering-only Grade R and cannot contribute ROI, Grade O, formal BUY, or promotion evidence.
chronological_fold_design.ordering: feature source <= candidate cutoff <= candidate generation <= freeze commit <= freeze persist ack < odds join <= quote request <= quote source event <= quote receipt <= quote selected as-of <= decision deadline < scheduled post
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No live or historical real race row may be read during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE.
chronological_fold_design.target_selection_rule: The entire 2026-08-02 Niigata card and race numbers 1 through 12 are fixed before observing race-day odds.

proposal_scope.data_as_of: 2026-08-01. The target is fixed as all 12 races of the 2026-08-02 2nd Niigata meeting day 4 card. Preparation reads only the registered synthetic manifest; no live candidate, quote, result, final odds, or payout row is read before APPROVED_TO_RUN.
proposal_scope.hypothesis: For every race in the non-odds pre-registered 2026-08-02 Niigata card, the approved research sidecar can bind one already-persisted WIDE_1 candidate to its exact strict T-3 wide quote, retain every failure as NO_BET, and produce a complete append-only engineering ledger with no candidate substitution, source-time violation, duplicate, or order side effect.
in_scope: Append one idempotent research decision event for every pre-registered race
Apply the already frozen realtime-paper robust expected-return thresholds without tuning
Collect only the exact race, wide ticket type, and frozen candidate-pair quote
Emit PAPER_READY only for the exact frozen pair when every contract and value gate passes
Emit and retain NO_BET with deterministic reason codes for every other target race
Measure completeness, duplicate count, quote availability, contract violations, and processing latency without calculating ROI
One-card Grade-R real-data engineering pilot only after APPROVED_TO_RUN
Pre-register the complete 2026-08-02 Niigata 12-race target card without using odds
Read one persisted non-odds WIDE_1 candidate-freeze record per target race
Retain quote request, source-event, receipt, selection-as-of, and decision timestamps
Synthetic fixture tests only during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE
Validate schedule lineage, starter-universe lineage, scratches known by T-3, market status, and quote freshness
Verify candidate record hash and persistence acknowledgement before any odds access
lineage_hash_requirements: Candidate freeze persistence acknowledgement must precede odds join and quote request
Candidate pair and candidate record hash must remain unchanged after odds access
Every output must set formal_buy false, send_order false, and paper stake zero
Every target race must have one decision ledger row even when the candidate, quote, schedule, universe, or value gate fails
Quote race, wide ticket type, and canonical pair key must match the frozen WIDE_1 candidate exactly
Quote source-event time, local received time, and selected-as-of time must all be at or before the strict T-3 cutoff
The pilot must not import or invoke any order-capable or production dashboard module
The target card, target race numbers, synthetic preparation cases, candidate freeze rows, configuration, schedule records, starter-universe snapshots, and quote captures must be hash-bound
proposal_scope.null_hypothesis: The one-card pilot cannot record every target race without missing rows, duplicate events, candidate mutation, invalid quote acceptance, source-time ambiguity, or order-capable side effects.
out_of_scope: Any backtest, ROI calculation, result join, final-odds analysis, threshold tuning, or model retraining
Any exclusion of a failed or unavailable target race from the engineering denominator
Any formal BUY, stake, credential access, purchase adapter, TARGET handoff, notification, or order transmission
Any odds-driven replacement of the frozen candidate horse, pair, ticket type, or target race
Any production dashboard, model, candidate, confidence, value threshold, or BUY-logic modification
Any real race-day access before APPROVED_TO_RUN
Any search across other pairs or ticket types after observing realtime odds
Any use of popularity, payoff, final odds, result, or post-race information as a candidate or decision input

primary_metric.baseline: approved single-race shadow sidecar without a complete pre-registered card runner and batch completeness audit
primary_metric.evaluation: All 12 pre-registered races, including every NO_BET and processing failure row
primary_metric.name: one_card_target_ledger_completeness

purge_embargo.candidate_market_firewall: The exact WIDE_1 candidate record must already exist and pass read-back hash verification before any odds adapter starts.
purge_embargo.post_event_embargo: No result, payout, final odds, popularity, or post-time information may be used by the candidate or decision path.
purge_embargo.target_selection_embargo: No race may be added, removed, or manually prioritized after observing odds.

proposal_scope.racing_mechanism: The frozen non-odds Top3-set model determines exactly one coherent WIDE_1 pair before market access. Realtime odds may only decide PAPER_READY versus NO_BET for that same pair under the already frozen robust-value threshold; they may never select another horse, pair, ticket, or race.
raw_data_sources: JRA official schedule snapshot with source, version, event time, and received time
JRA official wide-odds HTML restricted to each exact registered race and frozen pair
candidate_freeze_ledger.csv produced and read-back verified before odds access
starter-universe and scratch snapshots available by the strict T-3 decision time
rejection_gate: Any ROI calculation or target-race exclusion based on outcome
Any alternative pair search or substitution after observing odds
Any candidate hash, horse, pair, race, or ticket mutation after odds access
Any duplicate decision event or non-idempotent restart behavior
Any formal BUY, TARGET handoff, stake, credential, notification, or order side effect
Any invalid schedule, starter-universe change known by T-3, or candidate-freeze failure accepted
Any missing, wrong-race, wrong-pair, cutoff-late, receipt-late, or selection-late quote accepted as valid
Any pre-registered target race is absent from the final engineering ledger
Any production dashboard mutation or import of order-capable code
Any real race-day data access during preparation
stop_conditions: A candidate is replaced after odds are observed
A formal_buy, send_order, or actual stake field becomes active
A production or order-capable module is imported or executed
A target race cannot be represented by either PAPER_READY or a deterministic NO_BET reason
Candidate freeze persistence cannot be proven before odds join
JRA quote source, receipt, or selected-as-of time cannot be proven at or before strict T-3
Schedule or starter-universe lineage is absent or inconsistent
The registered target or synthetic manifest hash changes
proposal_scope.target_population: All 12 races at the pre-registered 2026-08-02 2nd Niigata meeting day 4 card, including confidence failures, quote failures, schedule failures, scratches, deadline misses, and processing failures. Preparation is limited to the registered synthetic manifest; the real one-card Grade-R engineering pilot requires a separate APPROVED_TO_RUN grant.
proposal_scope.title: One-card Grade-R strict T-3 engineering pilot
